It bears medium-sized fragrant white flowers in spring trusses on a rounded deciduous shrub well suited to a woodland-edge border in Southeastern gardens. Plant in consistently moist, acidic, humus-rich soil and avoid heavy pruning, since flower buds form on the previous year's growth.
